The '''LOS-0 sabotage probe droid''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] model produced by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] as a sabotage droid in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] combat. Once attached to an enemy [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the LOS-0 rapidly disabled the ship's thrusters and other systems while also dealing minor hull damage in the process. The probe droid was originally used primarily by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and law enforcement personnel to cripple fleeing starships.
